description: This file defines the VehicleService class, which provides methods to add a new vehicle and retrieve all vehicles, interacting with VehicleRepository and UserRepository.

classes.name: VehicleService
classes.description: A service class for managing vehicle entities, including adding new vehicles and retrieving all vehicles.

methods.name: addVehicle
methods.description: Creates a new Vehicle object from the request data, potentially associating a driver if driverId is provided, and saves it via VehicleRepository.

methods.name: getAllVehicles
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all Vehicle entities from the repository.
